_comment: The CLASSIC rulebook's modules, encoded. Same standing as `mantra_modules.json`: this file is
CONFIGURATION, read and never fitted, never inferred from observed line-ups, and never DEDUCED FROM
MANTRA BY ANALOGY - the operator's own warning of 10/08/2026, and it is the point of the file. Classic
legality is per MACRO-ROLE: a place is a P, a D, a C or an A, full stop. There are no typed places, no
hybrid places and no choice of roles, so nothing here needs the transversal matroid Mantra needs - a
classic eleven is legal if the COUNTS match, which is why the two games cannot share one table.
Source: the private-leagues regulation page (public, no paywall), retrieved 10/08/2026.
Quoted: «Utilizzare i moduli standard e cioe': 3-4-3, 3-5-2, 4-3-3, 4-4-2, 4-5-1, 5-3-2, 5-4-1».
TRANSCRIPTION CHECK, and it passed on all seven: each module's lines sum to ten outfield men, and the
three line counts reproduce the module's own NAME. Two independent checks, so the table was not mis-read.
The same page states the SYSTEM's per-role bounds a private league may configure between - «1/15P,
6/25D, 6/25C, 4/25A» - which is a squad question and belongs to `league_config.json`, not here. It is
quoted because it corroborates the shape of this file: classic rations MACRO-ROLES and nothing finer.
Consequences that need no model, only this file: a D is fielded 3, 4 or 5 at a time and an A 1, 2 or 3,
so the scarcity classic imposes per role IS a rulebook constraint - unlike Mantra, where the roster
binds 3 keepers + 22 outfield with no per-slot quota (that difference is exactly why the currency has to
be re-measured per format: `docs/model/metrica-asta-surplus-v1.md` §15 and todolist item 3.1).
_slot_roles_comment: One entry per macro-role, each accepting exactly itself. It exists so the same readers that walk
`mantra_modules.json` (`legal.placesOf`, `auction-value.slotShares`) can walk this file unchanged; it is
NOT a claim that classic has typed places. It does not.
_modules_comment: The seven standard modules, each as its lines beyond the fixed goalkeeper. `T` is empty in every one of
them: classic has no trequarti line - the module is three numbers, not four - and the key is kept only
so the structure matches the Mantra file's.
_emergency_comment: The same page allows emergency shapes «se si preferisce», naming 3-6-1 and 6-3-1. They are OPTIONAL and
per league, so they are recorded and switched OFF: a module a league does not play is a module that
would widen every legality test for nothing. A league that plays them moves them into `modules`.
Leaving them out is the conservative error - it can only make a squad's cover look worse than it is.
